title: 5" FPV Drone
description: Designed and assembled a custom 5-inch FPV racing drone from the ground up, integrating the flight controller, ESC, motors, FPV camera, and radio receiver. Tuned the flight system for stable and responsive performance while gaining practical experience in UAV electronics and system integration.

title: Soccer Bot
description: Designed and built a compact soccer robot capable of agile movement and ball control for robotic soccer competitions. Focused on mechanical design, motor control, embedded programming, and wireless operation to achieve precise navigation and teamwork.

title: Digital Weight Machine
description: Developed a digital weight measurement system using a load cell and microcontroller with an LCD interface. The system provides accurate weight measurements and features an integrated automatic coin dispensing mechanism for practical vending applications.

title: Smart Bin with Coin Dispenser & GSM Alert
description: Built an automated smart waste bin capable of monitoring usage while integrating an automatic coin dispensing system. Added GSM communication to send notifications and alerts, combining embedded control, sensor integration, and remote monitoring.

title: Smart Fire & Light Control System
description: Designed an intelligent safety and automation system that detects fire hazards and automatically controls lighting. Integrated environmental sensors with embedded control logic to improve safety, energy efficiency, and real-time response.

title: 2D Electrical Floor Plan Design (AutoCAD)
description: Designed detailed 2D residential floor plans in AutoCAD with complete electrical layouts, including conduit routing, wiring paths, lighting fixtures, switches, socket outlets, distribution boards, and other electrical components while ensuring organized and practical installation planning.

title: Smart Bin Simulation (Proteus)
description: Simulated the complete embedded system in Proteus, including microcontroller programming, sensor interfaces, GSM communication, and automatic coin dispensing to validate system functionality before hardware implementation.

title: Band-Pass Filter Design (LTspice)
description: Designed and analyzed an analog band-pass filter using LTspice. Simulated frequency response, gain, and bandwidth characteristics to evaluate circuit performance and optimize component selection.

title: Traffic Light Control System (Proteus)
description: Developed a Proteus-based traffic management simulation featuring automated traffic lights. Implemented sequential logic to improve traffic flow and simulate real-world intersection control.
